findings.description: Critical: installed supervise skill mirrors in .claude/skills/supervise/SKILL.md and .agents/skills/supervise/SKILL.md were not updated when canonical skills/supervise/SKILL.md was modified in commit d9c7f0a4, causing test_installed_supervise_skill_mirrors_are_byte_identical_when_present to fail on test execution.

none: artifact evidence calculation now converts source and as_of timestamps to UTC before date evaluation and forces git pathspecs to literal mode, preventing negative staleness bonuses and glob magic bypasses.

none: candidate manifest ranking strictly binds requested candidates byte-for-byte to the persisted store and provides a dedicated schema-valid empty digest publish path for zero-candidate operations.
none: digest transaction recovery fails closed by forcing host rehydration after rolling forward pending publication operations, preventing stale record state from overwriting recovered mirrors.
none: legacy supervisor record fixtures and sanitization layers are properly migrated to comply with canonical schema constraints including required route and roadmap_ref fields.
